methodology.measured: Synchronous client merge and renderer data-projection CPU on deterministic in-memory server pages.
methodology.retainedBytes: Exact UTF-8 JSON serialization and content+metadata bytes of unique retained messages, plus the production reducer's retained-byte accounting; these are deterministic payload-size proxies, not JavaScript heap measurements.
methodology.excluded: HTTP/database latency, React commit, Markdown/highlighter initialization, DOM measurement, image decode, compositor work, and Electron IPC.
methodology.interpretation: Compare ratios and scaling on the same machine. Sub-millisecond absolute timings are timer/JIT sensitive.

A_current_unbounded.behavior: Current older-only cursor; every loaded page remains in the active history.

B_bounded_older_only.behavior: Production older-only primary reducer capped at 500 messages and 2097152 retained bytes; returning newest uses its cached tail or reloads the latest page.

returnToNewestAfterCompleteOlderTraversa.note: The bounded primary window still contains the newest messages.

C_search_bidirectional.behavior: Same production bounded normal-history reducer as B; before/after expansion exists only in a separate bounded search/deep-link context lane.

returnToNewestAfterCompleteOlderTraversa.note: The bounded primary window still contains the newest messages.
